# TowerOpentelemetry v0.2.1 - Table of Contents

Tower reporter that records exceptions as OpenTelemetry span events following the OpenTelemetry semantic conventions for exceptions.

## Pages

- [tower_opentelemetry 🗼🔭](https://tower-opentelemetry.hexdocs.pm/readme.md)

## Modules

- [TowerOpentelemetry](https://tower-opentelemetry.hexdocs.pm/TowerOpentelemetry.md): A [Tower](https://github.com/mimiquate/tower) reporter that records captured
exceptions as OpenTelemetry span events, following the
[OTEL semantic conventions for exceptions](https://opentelemetry.io/docs/specs/semconv/exceptions/).
- [TowerOpentelemetry.Attributes](https://tower-opentelemetry.hexdocs.pm/TowerOpentelemetry.Attributes.md): Pure functions that translate a `Tower.Event` into OpenTelemetry semantic
convention attributes for exceptions.
